title: Shophouse bakery counter in oak and olive
summary: A long oak service counter with a fluted front and a stone-look top runs along a heritage shophouse unit. Olive wall tiles and warm pendants frame the bread display, while terrazzo-look flooring and timber shutters keep the shophouse character.
ideas: Fluted oak counter front with a rounded end
Glass bread display set into the counter run
Olive wall tiles behind the service area
Warm pendant lights over the counter
alt: Shophouse bakery-cafe with a long fluted oak counter, bread display and olive tiled wall (AI design concept)

title: Bright pharmacy-style wellness shop in light oak
summary: A pharmacy-style wellness shop with light oak gondola shelving islands, full-height oak wall shelving and a white-topped oak service counter at the back. Cream suspended panels mark zones under an even grid of downlights, with an olive feature wall and large beige floor tiles keeping the space calm and easy to browse.
ideas: Two-sided oak gondola islands with a deeper base shelf for heavier stock
Cream suspended panels above each zone for future category signs
Full-height wall shelving framing the service counter
Even downlight grid with an olive accent wall to soften the bright retail look
alt: Pharmacy-style wellness shop with light oak gondola shelving, wall shelving, a service counter and cream hanging panels (AI design concept)

title: Shophouse wine bar with oak bottle wall
summary: A warm shophouse wine bar built around a full-height light oak bottle wall with lit shelves and a hanging glass rack. A long charcoal bar top sits in front, lined with olive velvet stools on dark bases with brass footrings. Brass pendants and candles keep the lighting low, with a cream lounge corner behind.
ideas: Full-height oak bottle wall with warm under-shelf lighting
Charcoal bar top contrasting the light oak front panels
Olive velvet bar stools with brass footrings
Brass pendant lights hung low over the bar for a dim, intimate mood
alt: Shophouse wine bar with a lit light oak bottle wall, charcoal bar top, olive velvet stools and brass pendant lights (AI design concept)

title: Oak-lined car accessories showroom with olive plinths
summary: A car accessories showroom wrapped in light oak wall panels under black track lighting. Wheels and roof boxes sit on open oak shelves, a large display screen anchors the back wall, cream and olive plinths hold car care products and accessories, and a raised cream platform shows car seats beside a slatted wall of steering wheels.
ideas: Light oak wall panels with built-in open shelving for bulky items
Cream and olive plinths at different heights for product zones
Feature screen set into an oak frame on the back wall
Raised cream platform to display seats and larger accessories
alt: Car accessories showroom with light oak walls, track lighting, a wall screen, wheels and roof boxes on shelves, cream and olive product plinths and car seats on a raised platform (AI design concept)
